A '''king''' ruled the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] at the time [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] first made contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Though the [[King/Legends|king]] hoped to join the Republic, the leader of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], [[Allat Za]], did not, forcing the king to make Dac an independent ally of the Republic.<ref name="Strongholds" />
